name: agent-rsvp-ja
description: Native RSVP speed reader JA — Zig-built macOS app tuned for Japanese text and Aozora Bunko.
author: Evan Bacon <baconbrix@gmail.com>

scripts.build: zig build --release=small && bun build ./index.ts --target=node --outdir dist && cp zig-out/bin/agent-rsvp-native dist/agent-rsvp-native && chmod +x dist/index.js dist/agent-rsvp-native && (codesign --force --sign - dist/agent-rsvp-native 2>/dev/null || true)
